commentary.text: 90+12' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Portu (Girona) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.

90+7' 2 - 2 Ladislav Krejci (Girona) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom right corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:2.
90+5' Marcelino has decided to substitute Alex Baena and he is replaced by Pau Navarro (Villarreal).
90+3' Daley Blind (Girona) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+3' Although Donny van de Beek (Girona) is just on the bench, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+2' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Girona due to an offside in the build-up play.
90+2' Wait! Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has indicated he is going to review the Girona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the left post. What a beautiful shot.
85' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

84' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Paulo Gazzaniga makes a great save to stop his effort.
83' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
82' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
82' Having seen unsporting behavior, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Marcelino (Villarreal) is the recipient.
78' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is substituted due to injury. Marcelino gives a chance to Denis Suarez.
78' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
77' Poor challenge! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle.
73' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daley Blind (Girona) replacing Arnau Martinez.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donny van de Beek departs the field of play to be replaced by Portu (Girona).
73' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
72' That will be all from Yeremy Pino who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pau Cabanes (Villarreal).
72' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Thierno Barry will be replaced by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal).
71' Oriol Romeu (Girona) trips an opposition player and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals a foul.

66' 2 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Donny van de Beek (Girona) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Diego Conde, so the score changes to 2:1.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
64' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kiko Femenia (Villarreal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
62' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
59' Michel has decided to make a change. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) replaces Ivan Martin.
58' The game has come to an end for Bojan Miovski. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
55' Oriol Romeu (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
51' A cross from Bryan Gil (Girona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
51' David Lopez (Girona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
46' 2 - 0 Goal! Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes a short pass from Yeremy Pino in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net. 2:0.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Michel probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Arnaut Danjuma. He is replaced by Abel Ruiz (Girona).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle and it's Donny van de Beek (Girona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Bryan Gil (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
40' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
39' Girona are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
34' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Diego Conde is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
33' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
31' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Bryan Gil (Girona) for his blatant foul.
30' Donny van de Beek (Girona) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
26' A cross by Bryan Gil (Girona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
26' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle after Ladislav Krejci (Girona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:0.
22' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post!
21' Bryan Gil (Girona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
20' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had an easy-decision to make.
16' Girona fail to score from a corner as Diego Conde (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.
12' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
12' Ivan Martin (Girona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
11' Alex Baena (Villarreal) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
10' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.

7' What a save from Paulo Gazzaniga! Logan Costa (Villarreal) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
7' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
6' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
3' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
3' Logan Costa (Villarreal) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Girona win a free kick.
3' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

2' Bryan Gil (Girona) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Diego Conde has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Girona will take the kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will referee today's match.
